source_contract.meaning: both lower hero CTAs use the same source outline/secondary visual state

why_no_immediate_fix: Class names are not the winning computed style. Existing page256/global CSS may already make the first target CTA visually source-like. A blind class/style correction could regress a hero state that is already correct.
future_diagnostic_when_page256_browser_i: At a controlled desktop viewport compare source and target health/technology CTA background, border, text color, radius, height, padding and gap.
Check hover/focus-visible state of both source buttons if the browser workflow supports it safely.
Read current target winning CSS owners for .af-btn-primary/.af-btn-secondary under #af-sub-bio-hero.
If both target buttons already render source-equivalent despite different class names, close with no write.
Only if the health CTA remains visually filled/primary while source is outline should a page256-local override be prepared; preserve href/text and all contact buttons.
do_not: do not rename target classes merely to match source class strings
do not alter the hero contact phone/mail pills
do not change shared/global button rules
do not infer hover behavior from static markup
